For the cases in the study, it is assumed the plant proper occupies about 10 acres, leaving a buffer of 0.24 kilometer (0.15 mile) to the plant fence line. The quality of plant makeup water varies from source-to-source and site-to-site and can be expected to vary significantly throughout any given site, particularly if groundwater is utilized. In this study, 50 percent of the makeup water to the plant is sourced from a municipal publicly owned treatment works (POTW) and the remaining 50 percent is sourced from groundwater. 2.3 NATURAL GAS CHARACTERISTICS Natural gas is utilized as the feedstock for all three study cases, and its composition, higher heating value (HHV), and lower heating value (LHV) are presented in Exhibit 2-5. Natural gas properties are from the 2019 revision of the “Specification for Selected Feedstocks” QGESS document (NETL, 2019b), with the addition of a mercaptan used as a gas odorant (Gas Research Institute, 1992).
